description: A class attribute naming the only attributes instances can hold. It removes the per-instance `__dict__`.
The data descriptor Python creates on the class for each slot; it reads and writes a fixed position in the object.
Each class in the chain declares only the slots it adds. A class without `__slots__` gives its instances a `__dict__` again.
Generates `__slots__` from the dataclass fields and returns a new class (Python 3.10+).
The `TypeError` raised when a class inherits from two bases that both define non-empty slots.
